policy.construction: target template owns geometry; source donors never silently rewrite it
policy.style: family tone/value vocabulary may donate style relationships without donating silhouette
policy.parts: only FAMILY_REUSABLE parts with a satisfied target semantic zone are cross-template candidates
policy.alternateConstruction: promote to a separate template; never overlay
policy.roundTrip: neutral template/source fidelity is mandatory before variation

reusablePartCategories.MATERIAL_PATTERN: surface treatment that requires a target surface zone
reusablePartCategories.MOTIF: small decoration seated inside a declared surface zone
reusablePartCategories.ATTACHMENT: geometry added at an explicitly declared attachment edge
reusablePartCategories.HARDWARE: small rigid accent attached at an explicitly declared edge/zone
reusablePartCategories.REUSABLE_COMPONENT: proven family-reusable delta not yet semantically specialized
reusablePartCategories.ALTERNATE_CONSTRUCTION: different geometry; candidate template, never a composable part
